when.quote: Procedure for opening personal savings accounts.

info.about: Name, or email or user id, used to find the customer's record, plus any 2 of: date of birth, email, phone, address
info.ask: To verify your identity, could you give me your full name and two of these: your date of birth, email, phone number or home address?

info.about: How much the customer will keep in savings. This decides which accounts' minimum balances they can meet.
info.ask: How much do you plan to deposit in the savings account, and will you keep that amount there without withdrawals?

info.about: The most the customer can keep as a minimum balance
info.ask: Is that the most you can keep in savings? Some accounts require a higher minimum balance.

info.about: Whether the customer will take a Rho-Bank credit card to get a savings APY bonus
info.ask: Some Rho-Bank credit cards add a bonus to your savings APY. Would you consider opening a credit card?

info.about: Whether the customer has Rho-Bank+. The Gold Rewards Card requires it.
info.ask: Do you have a Rho-Bank+ subscription?

info.about: Age from the date of birth on file. It decides whether the customer can open age-restricted checking accounts (Light Green, Dark Green, Gold Years).
Each existing account's class, status, balance and date_opened. These are used for checking tenure, savings count, negative balances and the account to close.
Annual income. The customer enters it in their own credit card application.
info.ask: What is your annual income? You'll enter it in your card application.

steps.do: Look up the customer's record by the name, email or id they gave
steps.quote: Customer identity is verified in our systems.

steps.do: Check that 2 of the customer's DOB, email, phone or address match the record. Share no account details before this check passes.
steps.quote: 1) Verify identity

steps.do: Get the current time for the verification log and for tenure and fee date checks
steps.quote: Confirm an active checking account exists and meets the 14-day tenure requirement.

steps.do: Log the verification
steps.quote: Authenticate the customer and confirm identity verification status on file.

steps.do: Unlock the tool that lists the customer's bank accounts
steps.quote: Use get_all_user_accounts_by_user_id_3847 to retrieve the bank accounts (checkings, savings) for a customer.

steps.do: Get all of the customer's checking and savings accounts
steps.quote: Checking eligibility requirements for opening new accounts (existing account status, balances, account tenure, number of accounts)

steps.do: Confirm the customer has an active checking account held for at least 14 days, fewer than 5 personal savings accounts, and no collections or negative balances
steps.quote: Do not proceed if any item above is not met.

steps.do: If the customer wants to close the old checking account or open the new one first, explain why savings comes first: savings needs an existing active checking account held at least 14 days. A newly opened checking account does not qualify, and closing the old one first would leave no qualifying account. Open the savings now, then the new checking, then close the old one.
steps.if: the customer also wants to close their current checking account and/or open a new checking account
steps.quote: 5) Must have held their checking account for at least 14 days.

steps.do: Ask how much the customer will deposit and the most they can keep as a minimum balance. Ask whether they are open to a credit card and whether they have Rho-Bank+.
steps.quote: Discuss available personal savings account options with the customer.

steps.do: Find the highest-APY combination. Total APY = savings base APY + one checking boost from a listed pair + the single highest card bonus. Only consider savings accounts whose minimum balance the deposit can meet, checking accounts the customer is eligible for, and cards the customer can get. Weigh any annual fee against the extra interest. Pick one combination and recommend it; do not hand the customer a list of options.
steps.quote: The boost is additive to your savings account's base APY and any credit card APY bonuses you may already have.

steps.do: Recommend one combination and explain the APY math and the fee reasoning. With deposits under $10,000, no Rho-Bank+ and an age outside the age-restricted checking ranges, the combination is: Evergreen Account (checking) + Green Account (savings) + Silver Rewards Card = 4.0% + 0.55% + 0.45% = 5.0% APY, with no annual fee. EcoCard would give 5.05%, but its extra 0.05% does not cover its $50 annual fee. Get the customer's confirmation.
steps.quote: Capture the exact account_class string. It must be the full official name ending with “Account” (for example, “Silver Plus Account”, “Gold Account”).

steps.do: Unlock the account-opening tool
steps.quote: Use the open_bank_account_4821 tool with account_type set to 'savings' and the confirmed account_class.

steps.do: Open the savings account the customer confirmed

arguments.account_class: the confirmed savings class, e.g. 'Green Account'

steps.quote: Use the open_bank_account_4821 tool with account_type set to 'savings' and the confirmed account_class.

steps.do: Ask whether to transfer the opening deposit from checking now. If the customer will deposit it themselves, or the checking account has no funds, tell them they have 30 days to fund the account or it will be closed. Mention the account's minimum opening deposit and ongoing minimum balance.
steps.quote: If no: inform the customer they have 30 days to fund the account (via internal transfer or external deposit) or the account will be closed.

steps.do: Unlock the transfer tool
steps.if: the customer authorizes a transfer now and the checking account holds enough
steps.quote: If yes: use transfer_funds_between_bank_accounts_7291 to transfer the required amount from the customer’s checking account to the newly opened savings account.

steps.do: Transfer the opening deposit

arguments.amount: the amount confirmed with the customer

steps.if: the customer authorizes a transfer now
steps.quote: If yes: use transfer_funds_between_bank_accounts_7291 to transfer the required amount from the customer’s checking account to the newly opened savings account.

rules.rule: Savings needs an active Rho-Bank checking account held at least 14 days. A checking account opened in this conversation does not count.
rules.quote: 5) Must have held their checking account for at least 14 days.

rules.rule: If the only checking account has been open fewer than 14 days, do not open savings; tell the customer when they become eligible
rules.quote: Insufficient checking tenure: If the checking account has been open fewer than 14 days, advise the customer when they will become eligible.

rules.rule: The customer must hold fewer than 5 personal savings accounts
rules.quote: Customer currently holds fewer than 5 personal savings accounts.

rules.rule: The customer must have no accounts in collections and no negative balances
rules.quote: Customer has no accounts in collections and no negative balances.

rules.rule: A checking boost applies only for listed pairs. Evergreen Account (checking) + Green Account (savings) is a listed pair.
rules.quote: 3. Evergreen Account (checking) + Green Account (savings)

rules.rule: Only the highest checking boost applies; checking boosts do not stack
rules.quote: Only the highest applicable checking account APY boost is applied to the customer's savings account.

rules.rule: Only the highest credit card bonus applies, but it stacks with the checking boost. Recommend only one card.
rules.quote: Only the highest applicable credit card APY bonus is applied to the customer's savings account.

rules.rule: Green Account (savings): 4.0% base APY
rules.quote: The APY reflects the effect of compounding and is set at 4.0%.

rules.rule: Green Account (savings): $100 minimum opening deposit and $500 ongoing minimum balance
rules.quote: Keep your balance at or above $500.

rules.rule: Evergreen Account boosts a linked Green Account (savings) by +0.55%
rules.quote: Link a Green Account (savings): +0.55% APY boost

rules.rule: Silver Rewards Card adds +0.45% to Green Account (savings)
rules.quote: Silver Rewards Card: +0.45%

rules.rule: EcoCard adds +0.5% to Green Account (savings)
rules.quote: When you also hold an EcoCard, you receive an additional bonus of 0.5%.

rules.rule: EcoCard has a $50 annual fee. Its extra 0.05% over Silver Rewards covers the fee only on balances above $100,000.
rules.quote: Annual fee: $50.00.

rules.rule: Silver Rewards Card: no annual fee; requires a credit score of at least 680
rules.quote: Minimum credit score: $680

rules.rule: Silver Account savings: 2.5% below $10,000. With a Green Account (checking) boost of +0.25% and an EcoCard bonus of +2.2%, the total is 4.95%, below 5.0%.
rules.quote: If it is below that amount, the applicable APY for that day is 2.5%.

rules.rule: Silver Account savings gets +2.2% from EcoCard
rules.quote: EcoCard: +2.2%

rules.rule: Silver Plus Account requires a $2,500 minimum balance and earns Tier 1 at 3.0%. With Blue Account +0.35% and EcoCard +0.45%, it stays far below 5.0%.
rules.quote: Keep your balance at or above $2,500 to meet the ongoing requirement.

rules.rule: Bronze Account earns 2.0% base; even with all its boosts it stays below 5.0%
rules.quote: You earn interest at an APY of 2.0% on your balance.

rules.rule: Gold Account requires a $10,000 ongoing minimum. The minimum drops to $5,000 only with a Gold Rewards Card, which needs Rho-Bank+.
rules.quote: Ongoing minimum balance: $10,000

rules.rule: Gold Rewards Card requires a Rho-Bank+ subscription
rules.quote: premium subscription required: Yes

rules.rule: Light Green Account checking is only for ages 13 to 24
rules.quote: You must be the primary account holder and be between 13 and 24 years old to open the account.

rules.rule: Dark Green Account checking is only for ages 17 to 26
rules.quote: You can maintain the account through 26.

rules.rule: Gold Years Account checking requires age 62 or older
rules.quote: You must be at least 62 years old to qualify.

rules.rule: Bluest Account checking needs a $75,000 opening deposit
rules.quote: Deposit at least $75,000 to open your account.

rules.rule: Diamond Elite Card is by invitation only; do not recommend it
rules.quote: Membership is by invitation only (Yes).

rules.rule: Platinum Rewards Card has a $200 annual fee and gives Green Account (savings) only +0.35%
rules.quote: Annual fee: $200.00.

open_questions: The documents do not give the customer's credit score, so Silver Rewards Card approval (minimum score 680) is decided by the customer's application tool.

No document says whether checking maintenance fees should count against the APY gain. The Evergreen $6 monthly fee is waived only with a $500 minimum daily balance, and the customer's checking may be empty.
Silver Account doc 002 mentions a possible 0.025% relationship bonus for holding multiple products, but its conditions are unclear. Even with it, the Silver combination is 4.975%, below 5.0%.

Green Account (savings) FAQ says pairing with an EcoCard or a Green Rewards Card gives a 0.5% bonus, but doc 003 lists Green Rewards Card at +0.4%. Green Rewards Card documents exist only under business credit cards.
